page.layout: One printed column of year-by-year lists (a table): years in a narrow column to the left of a ruled bracket, names in the main column; running title "Reip. Groning." at the top. The right side of the page is not part of this transcription.; One printed page, cut at the left. Left of the vertical rule, the ends of two main-text lines ("ijt," and "Abel"). Right of the rule, one column of marginal notes running from top to bottom, ending with a brace-grouped block headed MORS.

note.i: Guilhelmus Ludovicus, comes Nassovius &c. Gubernator èvivis excesit pri. Kal. Iunias. cui in gubernatione huius provinciae successit Princeps Mauritius. 5 Ianuarij. 1621.
Societas Indiae occidentalis sive Americana instituta

marginalia.note: * Ernestus Casimirus comes Nassovius &c. factus Gubernator.
MORS. Vbbonis Emmii Historici 8. Octo. Hermanni Ravensberg Theologi 20. Octobris.

page.notes: The year figures are set beside the middle line of each group; the year cell is placed on the line it is printed beside. The "obi[?]" at the end of the 1624 line is uncertain where the scan edge cuts the word. The asterisk before 1625 is printed as a separate mark. The page is cut off at the left edge, so the main-text lines are only partly visible. "ijt," and "Abel" are cut fragments and may be incomplete. The brace-grouped block in the lower right margin is transcribed as a note. The name "Vbbonis Emmii" is printed in this form.
